targetTexts.1: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,
targetTexts.2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
targetTexts.3: The sons of Bela: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
targetTexts.6: These were the descendants of Ehud who were the heads of the families living in Geba and were exiled to Manahath:
targetTexts.7: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them into exile and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
targetTexts.8: Shaharaim had sons in the country of Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.
targetTexts.9: His sons by his wife Hodesh: Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
targetTexts.10: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
targetTexts.11: He also had sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.
targetTexts.12: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its villages),
targetTexts.13: and Beriah and Shema (who were the heads of families living in Aijalon and who drove out the inhabitants of Gath).
targetTexts.16: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
targetTexts.18: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
targetTexts.21: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
targetTexts.25: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
targetTexts.27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
targetTexts.28: All these were heads of families, the chiefs according to their genealogies, and they lived in Jerusalem.
targetTexts.29: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife’s name was Maacah,
targetTexts.30: and Abdon was his firstborn son, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
targetTexts.32: and Mikloth, who was the father of Shimeah. They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem.
targetTexts.33: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
targetTexts.34: The son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
targetTexts.35: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
targetTexts.36: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
targetTexts.37: Moza was the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.
targetTexts.38: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
targetTexts.39: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam was his firstborn, Jeush second, and Eliphelet third.
targetTexts.40: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and they had many sons and grandsons—150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.
